motion.evidence: Near-static by design. Zero scroll-linked effects, zero entrance reveals, zero parallax/cursor effects; rafCalls 0, no animation libraries, no canvas/video. The probe's two 'pin' scroll_effects are the fixed 55px nav and an empty toast region (chrome, not effects), and its single 'entrance' reveal (img opacity 0 -> 1 at 500ms) is a decode-gated load fade on an already-visible image, not an in-view animation. IntersectionObserver (1 observer, 28 targets, rootMargin 200px) is used to PREFETCH media ahead of the viewport, not to reveal it. 7 @keyframes exist in the bundle: an asymptotic loading bar (translateX -> 99% over 60s on cubic-bezier(0,1,1,1)), a 500ms alternate-infinite opacity skeleton pulse, and 5 toast enter/exit keyframes; the probe reported keyframeCount 0. Hover across all 12 captured interactive elements is one mechanism: color #333 -> #000 plus border-color transparent -> #DEDEDE (border reserved at transparent, so no reflow). Transition timings 50/100/125/200/250ms on ease-out/ease-in/ease.

a11y.focus_ring: outline: 1px solid #3D46C2 (bordered controls swap border-color to the same accent instead)
a11y.reduced_motion_note: TWO switches: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) AND html[data-reduced-motion='true'] — motion is exposed as an in-app user preference, not only an OS setting
a11y.img_alt_note: 1 of 1 images has alt — high ratio on a sample of one; weak evidence
a11y.small_tap_targets: 31 of 32 interactive (~97%) below 44px — price buttons are 24px tall, carousel arrows 24x24
a11y.note: defects: no <h1> anywhere (headings start at h3, broken document outline); prose links are bold-only with no underline or color shift; ~97% of interactive elements under the 44px touch floor

states.focus: outline 1px #3D46C2, or border-color -> #3D46C2 on bordered controls
states.disabled: background gray1, color gray4 (#999), pointer-events: none
states.input: bg gray1 -> gray2 on hover/focus, border-color -> focus accent, placeholder = slate

grid.note: prose is a centered span of the 12-col grid (CSS carries both a 5/span-4 and a 4/span-6 span across breakpoints; the 1440px screenshot matches 4/span 6 at ~650px)

responsive.note: body size is identical at 390px and 1440px — the measure narrows, the type never does

type_detail.note: the system defines 9 steps up to 3rem; the homepage spends only the bottom three. Section headings are 16px bold — hierarchy is weight + position + whitespace, with zero scale contrast

variable_axes.slnt: -12 (italic, synthesized slant rather than a drawn italic cut)
variable_axes.DRKM: 0 light / 1 dark — a custom dark-mode axis set globally from the theme token via font-variation-settings on <html>; the standard purpose is to compensate for the optical bolding of light text on dark grounds

theme.mechanism: a single class on <html> re-points one numbered ramp (gray0..gray7); components only ever name semantic aliases (--colors-background = gray0, --colors-foreground = gray7, --colors-link, --colors-slate). The ramp INVERTS rather than shifts, so every alias keeps its meaning. mix-blend-mode is itself a token (--colors-blend: multiply | screen)

elevation.note: a shadow token exists and is never used on this page; zero gradients anywhere

notes: Normalized from the light theme (the captured default). fg is #333 (--colors-gray6 / --colors-link), NOT the #000 that --colors-foreground resolves to: #000 is held in reserve as the hover/emphasis state, and #333 is what 92 of the page's text nodes actually render. The system's semantic red/green/blue channel ramps exist but never appear on the homepage — normalized into roles, not promoted. There is NO chroma in the page body: the only saturated surfaces are the navy footer ground (#00075F) and the focus ring (#3D46C2). The stylesheet carries a `premium-true` variant that borders the Premium plan row with the accent, but the screenshot shows both plan rows with the plain #DEDEDE hairline (borderColor census: exactly 2 elements at #DEDEDE) — the variant is not applied, so it is not recorded as a page color. The space scale is deliberately non-doubling (5/10/15/20/25 additive at the micro end, then ~x1.35 through 35/45/65/80/100/130) and the same eleven values serve as both --space-* and --sizes-*. Dark palette is taken from the stylesheet's own `dark` theme class, not inferred. Probe corrections: it reported respectsReducedMotion false, keyframeCount 0, prmRules 0 and carousels 0 — the CSS has a global prefers-reduced-motion kill switch plus a user-preference twin, 7 @keyframes, and there is a carousel (JS index swap over one , 5s autoplay, so no DOM track for the probe to detect).
